purpose: P5: reproducible before/after of the V10/V11 studies on the qualified PIT S&P 500 population (fund holdings, incl. exits, bounded cases) with corrected PIT market cap; P6: at most six complete, pre-specified trading strategies (entry/exit, market filter, cash, risk management) on the same basis, evaluated by market phase. Data quality before strategy optimisation: no variant search, no parameter tuning, no alpha claim and no generalisation that strategies cannot add value.
priorExposure: All V10 and V11 results are known (docs/quant-recovery/BACKTEST_V10_*.md, ALPHA_DISCOVERY_V11.md, v11/decomposition): population effect of the equal-weighted survivor frame vs SPY, selection -0.6..+0.5 pp per 13 W, V10 factor ICs (quality/profitability/momentum/composite positive at 1M, value weak), V11 H1/H2 quality and profitability+momentum lost to SPY 2021-2025, low-volatility and momentum families known from V7-V11 on the same history.

V12 strand outputs known before this registration: SPXPOP periods-1.1.0 (cap-weighted member return rPoint vs SPY per period, bounded weights, the three failing periods 2012-09, 2014-03, 2015-03), INDEXPOP coverage-1.2.0 (share of members with a qualified series per year), MCAP impact-1.0.0 (V10 factor ICs before/after the market-cap correction on the survivor frame).

Computed by this strand before registration (outcome-free): lifecycle frame size (4,329 listings; source manifest hash 37a1d45a... differs from the V11 run 2c27039f... because the CA register moved to 1.1.2 - disclosed), member counts and securityId shares per period of PIT_SP500, panel rank-date range 2010-01-29..2025-12-26. No equal-weighted return, no strategy return, no factor IC on the index population and no regime label was computed.

The parameters below (quintiles, top 30, 10-month line, 15 % vol target, 10 % buffer, 45 % reduced equity, costs) are conventional choices fixed without looking at any outcome on this population; they were NOT optimised. Owner suggestions (2) to (6) were adopted as worded.

marketCap.panels: private V12 MCAP panels <v12-private>/mcap/{before,after}/panel.jsonl.gz (V10 factor code, survivor frame, monthly rank dates 2010-01-29..2025-12-26); sha256 recorded in every output

frame.rule: scripts/quant/v10/studies/common.cjs buildFrame (V10/V11 survivor frame incl. 121 ended listings)

spyDistributions.source: SEC N-30D annual reports of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (CIK 884394), fiscal year Oct-Sep

cash.rule: cash accrues the effective federal funds rate: prod over calendar days of (1 + EFFR_d/100/360), EFFR_d = last observation <= d

commonDefinitions.periods: PIT_SP500 periods of the qualified span 2009-09-30 -> 2026-06-30 (47 periods; semiannual 31.3./30.9. until 2019-03, one 6-month period 2019-03 -> 2019-09, quarterly from 2019-09). The three non-qualified periods inside the span (2012-09 -> 2013-03, 2014-03 -> 2014-09, 2015-03 -> 2015-09) are INCLUDED (allowUnqualified) and flagged; sensitivity: statistics over the 44 qualified periods only.
commonDefinitions.signalSpan: Studies needing factor-panel signals (P5c, P6): periods whose t0 has a panel rank date r with t0 - 35 days <= r <= t0 -> t0 in 2010-03-31 .. 2025-12-31 (45 periods). S1 is additionally reported from 2009-09-30.
commonDefinitions.membership: Member set at t0 = fund holdings of SPY at t0. Index membership was public at the time (S&P announcements); the SEC filing date of the holdings report is NOT used as availability (stated limitation).
commonDefinitions.memberReturn: Holdings price return t0 -> t1 of the module (R = s * p1/p0 - 1, observed/estimated statuses), bounded cases by scenario.

scenarios.ZERO: bounded exits at 0 % (module boundedAs ZERO); BOUNDED_AMBIGUOUS_CA at the midpoint of its two hypotheses (lower+upper)/2
scenarios.LOWER: bounded exits at -100 % and BOUNDED_AMBIGUOUS_CA at its lower hypothesis (module boundedAs LOWER)
scenarios.rule: every P5a/P5c/P6 result is reported under both scenarios; ZERO is the point estimate, LOWER the survivorship lower bound

commonDefinitions.withSeries: A member "has our series" at t0 if its securityId (INDEXPOP T1/T2) is a frame listing whose weekly series has a bar in [t0 - 6 days, t0] and listingStart <= t0.
commonDefinitions.seriesReturn: Weekly series return from the last bar <= t0 (>= t0 - 6 days) to the last bar <= t1 (>= t1 - 6 days). If the series ends before t1 - 6 days: lifecycle terminal CASH_MERGER -> cashPerShare / close(t0) - 1, otherwise last close (V10 LAST_CLOSE); sensitivity -100 % for these cases (counted).
commonDefinitions.spyPrice: SPY daily close at the last trading day <= t0 and <= t1 (exact dates). For weekly-series comparisons additionally SPY at the same weekly bar dates.
commonDefinitions.spyTotalReturnReference: Per calendar quarter q: y_q = D_FY(q) / 4 / SPY_close(start of q), D_FY = N-30D distributions per unit of the fiscal year (Oct-Sep) containing q; TR_period = prod_q (1 + priceReturn_q + y_q) - 1 over the quarters of the period. FY2026 (Oct 2025 - Sep 2026) not yet reported -> FY2025 value carried forward and flagged. Diagnostic: comparison with the N-PORT fund total return 2019-09+. Approximation; used only as reference because no strategy side is total-return capable (member returns are holdings price returns).
commonDefinitions.returnBasis: PRICE_RETURN on both sides for every comparison; SPY total return only as a separately labelled reference (benchmark-definition term).
commonDefinitions.aggregation: Chain-linked period returns; CAGR over the exact calendar span (365.25-day years); per-period differences in percentage points; annualised differences = CAGR differences.

R1_SPY_RULE.inputs: SPY daily closes. R = period price return; DDin = min over trading days d in (t0, t1] of close_d / max(close over [t0, d]) - 1; DD52 = close(t0) / max(close over the 252 trading days ending t0) - 1.
rule: RECOVERY if not CRASH_BEAR and (previous period CRASH_BEAR or DD52 <= -10 %) and R > 0
SIDEWAYS if none of the above and |R| <= 2.5 % * sqrt(months / 3)

R2_OWNER_CALENDAR.rule: Label by the calendar midpoint of the period, priority CRASH_BEAR > RECOVERY > SIDEWAYS > OTHER.

regimes.note: Regimes are ex-post descriptive labels, fixed before any strategy outcome; semiannual periods make the labels coarse (stated).

series.SPY_W: SPY price return at the weekly bar dates
series.EW_ALL: equal-weighted all PIT S&P 500 members (holdings returns, scenario)
series.EW_WITH_H: equal-weighted members WITH our series, holdings return
series.EW_FRAME: equal-weighted survivor frame (all frame listings with a bar at t0, V10/V11 population), weekly-series return, period buy-and-hold
series.EW_FRAME_WREB: V11 definition: weekly rebalanced equal-weighted frame index between the same bar dates

a_population.identity: EW_FRAME - SPY = (EW_FRAME - EW_WITH_S) [universe: survivor titles outside the index] + (EW_WITH_S - EW_WITH_H) [measurement: weekly series vs holdings, dates] + (EW_WITH_H - EW_ALL) [survivorship INSIDE the index] + (EW_ALL - SPY) [equal weighting inside the index]; plus SPY_TR - SPY [benchmark definition] and EW_FRAME_WREB - EW_FRAME [rebalancing frequency]. Exact per period.
a_population.reports: per period, chain-linked CAGR, mean per-period difference with Newey-West SE (bandwidth 2 periods), subspans 2009-09..2019-09 and 2019-09..2026-06, by regime R1 and R2; under ZERO and LOWER; qualified-only sensitivity. Counts of members with/without series, bounded weights.

b_signalDecomposition.signalTiming: V10/V11 unchanged: detection at weekly close k (signal-backtest.js), eligibility eligibleAt(k, WARMUP+COOLDOWN), entry close k+1, exit after h weeks on a contiguous calendar path; costs 10 + 5 bps per side (netOf).
b_signalDecomposition.sp500Restriction: event counted if the listing is a PIT S&P 500 member at the latest population date t0 <= signal date (member securityId = frame id); population term = mean forward return of all eligible S&P-member frame observations of the same week.
steps: FRAME_2009: same code on the full frame, window 2009-10..2025 (window effect)
SP500_WITH_SERIES: events and population restricted to S&P members (population effect)
SP500_ALL_ESTIMATE: population term shifted by the within-index survivorship gap of P5a (EW_WITH_H - EW_ALL per period, scaled to h weeks by h / weeks of the period; estimate, ZERO and LOWER)
b_signalDecomposition.terms: rawNet = SPY + (Pop - SPY) + (Signal - Pop) - cost (exact identity)
b_signalDecomposition.inference: research-validation.inferTemporalBlockMean on the study calendar (block 52 for 13 W, 104 for 52 W, 1,999 replicates, seed 1729), Holm over 5 rules x 2 horizons x 3 terms = 30 per step; observed vs secured.

c_factor.periodGrid: signalSpan periods (45), rank date = latest panel date in [t0 - 35 d, t0]
steps: S0 V10_PUBLISHED: docs/quant-recovery/v10/factor/factor-study-1.0.0.json (monthly, survivor frame, old market cap) - reference only
S1 FRAME_BEFORE: survivor frame listings with a panel row and a bar at t0; scores of the BEFORE panel as built; outcome = weekly series return t0 -> t1
S2 FRAME_AFTER: as S1 with the AFTER panel (corrected PIT market cap) -> market-cap effect
S3 SP_SERIES: S&P members with series and a panel row; scores re-normalised inside this subset (factors.cjs scoreCrossSection on AFTER raws); outcome weekly series -> population effect
S4 SP_HOLDINGS: same members and scores; outcome = holdings return incl. exits (ZERO / LOWER) -> exit/survivorship effect
D1 diagnostic: S&P members with series, AFTER full-frame scores (normalisation effect S3 vs D1)
c_factor.endpoints: per period Spearman rank IC (observed outcomes), quintile means Q1..Q5 (ties by securityId), Q5 - Q1, Q5 - EW(scored), Q5 - SPY; min 100 scored members with outcome per period
c_factor.inference: Newey-West (bandwidth 2 periods) on per-period IC and spread; Holm over 7 signals per endpoint for S4 ZERO; few periods -> stated as observed unless secured.

P5.d_attribution: Synthesis per difference (population, selection, costs, benchmark price vs TR, total return, portfolio construction) with explanatory text in the README and attribution JSON; no new outcome definition.

P6.rebalancing: at each population date t0; targets fixed at t0, buy-and-hold to t1; exited members become cash at their scenario value at t1 (no cost); weights drift with returns
P6.universe: PIT S&P 500 members at t0; selectable = members with a panel row at the rank date (securityId = panel id); scores re-normalised inside the selectable subset (scoreCrossSection on AFTER raws); ties broken by securityId; templates (banks/insurers/REITs) have no quality/profitability score and are not selectable for S3/S4.
P6.marketFilter: SPY close on the last trading day <= t0 above the mean of the last 10 month-end closes (month ends <= t0, the t0 month included when t0 is a month end)

strategies.rule: equal weight all members (incl. members without series)
top quintile of the V10 momentum score, equal weight
strategies.exposure: 100 % if market filter on, else 100 % cash (EFFR)

strategies.rule: top quintile of mean(quality score, profitability score) (both required), equal weight
top 30 by mean(momentum score, mean(quality, profitability)) (all required), equal weight, max position e/30 <= 3.33 %
strategies.exposure: e = min(1, 0.15 / sigma), sigma = annualised (sqrt 52) std of the 52 weekly returns to the last bar <= t0 of the equal-weighted basket of the 30 names (names with >= 26 weekly returns in the window; weekly EW over available names); rest cash (EFFR)

strategies.rule: lowest quintile of realizedVolatility252d (panel raw), equal weight

strategies.exposure: equity 90 % if market filter on, 45 % if off; rest cash (EFFR)

costs.base: 10 + 5 bps per side on traded notional
costs.traded: sum_i |w_target,i - w_drifted,i| over equity positions (cash leg free); initial purchase counted

P6.metrics: CAGR, annualised volatility sqrt-time-scaled from period log returns, Sharpe = annualised mean excess log return over cash / its annualised SD, MaxDD on the population-date equity curve (period granularity; SPY daily MaxDD shown for scale), turnover, cost drag, average equity share, CAGR difference vs SPY price, vs SPY TR reference (mixed basis, labelled), vs S1 (EW S&P), vs EW_WITH_H (selectable universe) -> selection term.
P6.regimes: mean per-period excess vs SPY and vs S1 by R1 and R2 labels, with period counts
P6.inference: z_i = (ln(1+r_i) - ln(1+b_i)) * n / years; Newey-West (bandwidth 2) and circular block bootstrap (block 4 periods, 9,999 replicates, seed 20261029) on mean(z); Holm over 11 tests (6 strategies vs SPY, S2-S6 vs S1) per scenario and cost level; ~11 blocks -> bootstrap NOT robust, stated; secured only if Holm <= 0.05 in both procedures.
P6.survivorship: ZERO and LOWER for every result; bounded weight held per strategy counted.

verification: Independent Python (stdlib, python3 -I): all P5a series per period from the raw population file, an exported frame series file and the raw SPY/EFFR series; one P6 strategy (S5_LOWVOL_Q1, ZERO, base costs) with its own volatility computation from the weekly series. A second language is not a holdout.
